meta.title: eRFX Auction stage, one clause Required: the vendor accepts both clauses

plan.title: eRFX Auction Required and Optional T&C Acceptance

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen with the default Auction stage.
Provide the mandatory event title so the event can be published.
Apply an Auction template before adding line items.
Add one item for the vendor to quote.
Complete the Auction pricing sheet for the added item.

args.goal: on the Auction create screen, open Terms & Conditions, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days", set "Payment within 45 days" to Required, leave "Delivery within 7 days" as None, click Done, and stop when the create screen shows the saved terms configuration

steps.note: Configure and verify the required and optional event terms, which have no dedicated catalog action.
Invite one QA vendor to the Auction event.
Publish the configured event so the vendor can access it.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Open the separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event's Auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Accept the optional delivery clause as required by the scenario.
Quote 100 for every line item and submit the vendor bid.
Verify that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
